tasks.subject: Task 1: course.fit exporter (pure core)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure `buildCourseFit` that encodes a FIT Course (track records + one named course_point per control), proven by a round-trip decode test.

**Verify:** `npm test -- fitCourse`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["packages/core/src/output/fitCourse.ts", "packages/core/src/output/course.ts", "packages/core/src/index.ts", "packages/cli/tests/fitCourse.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- fitCourse", "acceptanceCriteria": ["buildCourseFit returns Uint8Array", "decoded file type is course named Vatternrundan cycling", "one named course_point per control with planned HH:MM", "record count equals microsegment count and distance monotonic", "course_point positions round-trip within 0.0002 deg"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Write course.fit from the CLI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The CLI writes `output/course.fit` alongside `course.gpx`, and the end-to-end test asserts it is a decodable course file.

**Verify:** `npm test -- cli.test`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["packages/cli/src/fileIo.ts", "packages/cli/src/cli.ts", "packages/cli/tests/cli.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- cli.test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["writeCourseFit writes decodable FIT bytes", "runPlan writes course.fit and lists it in artifacts (six)", "cli.test asserts course.fit decodes as a course file"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Web Downloads course.fit + install card
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The web app downloads `course.fit` and shows install instructions instead of emitting the per-plan `PlanDelta.mc` source.

**Verify:** `npm run typecheck && npm test -- web`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/web/src/components/Downloads.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run typecheck && npm test -- web", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no generatePlanDeltaSource import or call", "course.fit download button calls buildCourseFit", "Garmin group shows install steps", "typecheck passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Static Next Control Pace field + build:ciq
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A committed, generic Monkey C data field and a `npm run build:ciq` that compiles it to a sideloadable `.prg`.

**Verify:** `npm run build:ciq && npm run typecheck`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["ciq/source/NextControlPace.mc", "ciq/resources/settings/settings.xml", "ciq/resources/settings/properties.xml", "ciq/manifest.xml", "ciq/monkey.jungle", "ciq/resources/strings/strings.xml", ".gitignore", "packages/cli/src/buildCiq.ts", "package.json"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build:ciq && npm run typecheck", "acceptanceCriteria": ["NextControlPace.mc custom DataField with segment detection, smoothing, per-control delta, 4 layouts, passed screen, fallbacks", "settings expose layoutMode/units/showPlanDelta", "gitignore tracks static .mc", "build:ciq compiles or exits 0 when SDK absent"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Retire the per-plan PlanDelta generator
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Delete the old generator, template, its test, and all references, keeping the build green.

**Verify:** `npm test && npm run typecheck`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["packages/core/src/ciq/generate.ts", "packages/core/src/ciq/template.ts", "packages/core/src/ciq/PlanDelta.mc.tmpl", "packages/core/tests/ciq.test.ts", "packages/cli/src/ciqCompile.ts", "packages/core/src/index.ts", "packages/cli/src/cli.ts", "packages/cli/tests/cli.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test && npm run typecheck", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no source references PlanDelta/generatePlanDeltaSource/buildLookupTable/generateCiq/noCiqCompile", "RunSummary has no ciq field and runPlan does no per-plan compile", "full suite and typecheck pass"]}
```
